<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914033_theRebbe_108__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the love of "with all your very being" is not demanded of every individual, which is why the second paragraph of the Shema only mentions "with all your heart and with all your soul."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this is the reason that in the second portion of the Shema it is only stated "with all your heart and with all your soul"44,</t>
    <t s="2">because the love of "with all your very being,"</t>
    <t s="3">since it comes through the revelation of the Ein Sof that is not within the category of worlds at all,</t>
    <t s="4">is not [demanded] of every individual45.</t>
    <t s="5">And that which is demanded of every individual is the love that comes from the aspect of the light that fills and the light that surrounds.</t>
    <t s="6">And similarly regarding the three matters of "turn from evil, do good, and seek peace,"</t>
    <t s="7">in many places only the two matters of "turn from evil and do good" are mentioned.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that through the love of "with all your very being," which is beyond will, one draws down a new will from the Ein Sof, the Master of Will, thereby achieving true atonement.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known46</t>
    <t s="2">that this, that through repentance the forgiveness of sins is effected,</t>
    <t s="3">(for the true meaning of forgiveness is that the person should be pleasing before Him as before the sin,)</t>
    <t s="4">is,</t>
    <t s="5">because through repentance one draws down a new will from the Ein Sof, the Master of Will,</t>
    <t s="6">which is above the will of the Torah and mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="7">And this drawing down is through his repentance being in the manner of "with all your very being,"</t>
    <t s="8">above measure and limitation.</t>
    <t s="9">As is known47</t>
    <t s="10">that through the love of "with all your very being" one "does the will of the Place,"</t>
    <t s="11">and the explanation of "does the will of the Place" is that they make the will.</t>
    <t s="12">For through the love of "with all your very being,"</t>
    <t s="13">they reach the Ein Sof that is above will,</t>
    <t s="14">and through this,</t>
    <t s="15">they draw down from there a new will48.</t>
    <t s="16">And according to the known principle49</t>
    <t s="17">that the service of man through which the drawing down is effected must be similar to the drawing down,</t>
    <t s="18">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="19">that the two matters in "doing the will of the Place"—</t>
    <t s="20">that the drawing down is from the Ein Sof that is above the aspect of will, and that the will drawn from there is also higher than the will as it is in itself—</t>
    <t s="21">are effected through the parallel of these two matters in the love of "with all your very being."</t>
    <t s="22">For since the love of "with all your very being" is above will</t>
    <t s="23">(and as mentioned above in section 4, that the self-sacrifice of "with all your very being" is not that he wants to give his soul, but that he cannot separate, G-d forbid, from His Oneness),</t>
    <t s="24">therefore it reaches the Master of Will50.</t>
    <t s="25">And this, that through the love of "with all your very being" an elevation is also effected in the love of "with all your heart and with all your soul,"</t>
    <t s="26">through this,</t>
    <t s="27">also the will that is drawn from the Master of Will is more elevated.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Return, O Israel, until Hashem your G-d" indicates that repentance must be in the manner of "with all your very being," drawing from the Ein Sof above the name Havayah, so that Havayah becomes your G-d.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is "Return, O Israel, until Hashem your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the reason the two names Havayah and Elokim are stated here is,</t>
    <t s="3">because the matter and service of each Jew is with these two names.</t>
    <t s="4">And since the matter of repentance is that he return and go back to his place,</t>
    <t s="5">therefore the two names Havayah and Elokim are stated here.</t>
    <t s="6">And this that it says "until Hashem your G-d"</t>
    <t s="7">(and not "to Hashem your G-d")</t>
    <t s="8">is,</t>
    <t s="9">according to the explanation of the Alter Rebbe51,</t>
    <t s="10">that the measure of repentance52</t>
    <t s="11">is until Havayah becomes your G-d.</t>
    <t s="12">That is,</t>
    <t s="13">that repentance must be in the manner of "with all your very being,"</t>
    <t s="14">above measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="15">through which is the drawing down from the Ein Sof that is above Havayah,</t>
    <t s="16">for this matter</t>
    <t s="17">(that the drawing down is from the Ein Sof that is above Havayah)</t>
    <t s="18">is revealed in that Havayah is your G-d, your strength and your vitality.</t>
    <t s="19">For in order for the union of the Surrounding</t>
    <t s="20">(Havayah)</t>
    <t s="21">and the Filling</t>
    <t s="22">(Elokim)</t>
    <t s="23">to be, it is through the drawing down being from the Ein Sof that is above Havayah53.</t>
    <t s="24">And this is what the verse continues, "for you have stumbled in your iniquity,"</t>
    <t s="25">which is the reason that repentance must be in this manner,</t>
    <t s="26">for since you have stumbled in your iniquity,</t>
    <t s="27">therefore the service of "with all your heart and with all your soul" that comes from the names Elokim and Havayah is insufficient,</t>
    <t s="28">and the service of "with all your very being" is required,</t>
    <t s="29">in order that there be a drawing down from the Ein Sof that is above Havayah.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
